dog.description_text: Meet Baloo — New Arrival! Baloo just arrived and is still getting settled in, so we’re just beginning to learn who they are. Right now, everything is new—new people, new sounds, new routines—and we’re giving them time to relax, decompress, and show us their true personality at their own pace. Here’s what we know so far from his time in foster care: https://bestfriends.sharepoint.com/:b:/r/sites/GRP_NYC_Foster/Shared%20Documents/Forms/AllItems.aspx?id=%2Fsites%2FGRP%5FNYC%5FFoster%2FShared%20Documents%2FGeneral%2FBaloo%20%2D%20About%20Me%2Epdf&parent=%2Fsites%2FGRP%5FNYC%5FFoster%2FShared%20Documents%2FGeneral&p=true&share=cQpaBtPpjzg9QpmHo2WVbojLEgUDtjEZtJt5ElQw0fBV8NAKag His foster says "Baloo was at home immediately. He is friendly, curious and playful. He loves sleeping on laps (he’s so small!) or in a cat tree. Baloo is such a sweetheart and would make a great addition to any home. He’s also great with visitors. He loves my resident cat, and if he’s not following him around, he’s at my feet purring. He is just always so happy. I’ve never had a foster acclimate so quickly." He is a very affectionate lap cat who is social and a complete delight. He enjoys playing and likes to cuddle. He is neutered, vaccinated, microchipped, and has had preventative treatments to ensure he is ready for his next steps. If you’re open to a little patience and a lot of possibility, come meet Baloo! You might be the person who helps them feel safe, confident, and right at home. Check back for updates—or stop by to say hello and discover who Baloo is becoming.
dog.name: Baloo
